description_en: Modifies the redirect configuration of a site
description_zh: 修改站点的重定向配置
name: UpdateRedirectRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2867474.html operation to obtain the configuration ID
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content. A conditional expression is used to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
The redirect type. Valid values:

static: static pattern.
dynamic: dynamic pattern
parameters.help_zh:
重定向类型。取值范围：

static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The target URL after the redirect
parameters.name: target_url

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP status code used when the node responds to the client with the redirect address. Valid values:

301
302
303
307
308
parameters.help_zh:
节点给客户端响应重定向地址时候使用的响应状态码。取值范围：

301
302
303
307
308
parameters.name: status_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to preserve the query string. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
保留查询字符串。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: reserve_query_string

parameters.help_en: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
